QuestInfo.name: Nella's Request
QuestInfo.0: Nella has a new job for you.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate Muddy Swamp Monsters, retrieve the stolen First-Aid Box, and place it in Naora Hospital. Muddy Swamp Monsters can be found in the #m103030300#.
QuestInfo.2: You returned the First-Aid Box to Naora Hospital.

0.0: Duey was passing through the Swamp Region to deliver a First-Aid Box to Kerning City, but a Muddy Swamp Monster stole it.
0.1: Hunt the Muddy Swamp Monsters in the #m103030300# and retrieve the #bFirst-Aid Box#k. You up to the job?

yes.0: Be careful. Oh, and don't deliver the First-Aid Box back to me. Take it straight to #bNaora Hospital#k, okay? I'd do it myself, but...I don't wanna.

no.0: I promise you, JM doesn't have any jobs this good.

1.2: Give it...to me. I know where it belongs...

yes.0: I put the First-Aid Box back. But I'm still lonely and cold... I wish I had a friend...

default.0: It's simple. Eliminate Muddy Swamp Monsters. Get the First-Aid Box. Then take it to Naora Hospital.

npc.0: Take it to Naora Hospital. That place gives me the...I mean, I don't believe in ghosts.
